title: pinUpdate silently drops any update value that is the string "tenantId" (e.g. $set {label:'tenantId'}, $push) and passes non-operator top-level keys through ({$set:{a:1}, tenantId:'A'})
area: packages/db/src/lib/tenantScope.ts pinUpdate (filter v !== "tenantId"; non-object bodies copied as-is)
evidence: Probe over a recording fake: upd({$set:{label:'tenantId'}}) -> {$set:{}}; upd({$set:{a:1},tenantId:'A'}) -> forwarded unchanged. No reachable exploit: a mixed document is rejected by the MongoDB server ('Unknown modifier'), and $rename to 'tenantId.x' fails because tenantId is a string. No current caller sends such shapes (callers grep'd).
fix_direction: File-dont-fix (low): only drop a value for $rename; reject top-level keys not starting with '$'.

title: No test pins that pinUpdate drops dotted tenantId.* paths
evidence: Mutation M7 (remove the startsWith clause) survived tenantScope.write/tenantScope/scoped-write/store-mongo-snapshot tests. HEAD behaviour is correct ({$set:{'tenantId.x':1,k:2}} -> {$set:{k:2}}).
fix_direction: File-dont-fix (low): add one dotted-path case to the 7 operator shapes.
